select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.issue_price issuePrice, fpd.issue_amt issueAmt, fpd.issue_Type issueType, fpd.CCY ccyCode, fpd.CCY ccy, '' investType, '' raiseType, to_char(fpd.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(fpd.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate, to_char(fpd.iDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') idate, to_char(fpd.actmdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') actmdate, fpd.MDATE-fpd.vDATE term, 'A/365' basis, ext.sale_period salePeriod, case when coalesce(ext.sale_layer,0)!=0 then 'Y' else 'N' end isSaleLayer,
ext.profit_flag prdIncomeType, ext.profit_flag prdIncomeTypeCode, ext.IS_RECONCILIATION isReconciliation, fpd.o_Finprod_Id oFinprodId, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, SUM(amt.trade_amt) planraiseAmt, decode(bbext.PARAM_VALUE,'Y','true','false') isTrustCurrent, fpd.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, C.CALENDAR_NAME AS calendarName from FIN_PRODUCT fpd
left join FIN_PRODUCT_add ext on fpd.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id /*and fpd.finprod_type = ext.finprod_type*/ /*产品信息查询募集金额查询不到bug修改*/ left join ( select sum(tpd.trade_amt) trade_amt,tpd.finprod_id,tpd.settle_date from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where 1=1 AND (tpd.finprod_type = #{finprodType} or tpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF22}) group by tpd.finprod_id,tpd.settle_date )amt on fpd.finprod_id = amt.finprod_id and amt.settle_date = fpd.VDATE
LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO C ON C.CALENDAR_ID = fpd.CALENDAR_ID /*产品信息查询募集金额查询不到bug修改*/ LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbext ON bbext.BOOKSET_ID = fpd.finprod_id AND bbext.PARAM_CODE = 'PRD_IS_CALC' where 1=1
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND fpd.profit_Type in
#{profitType}
AND fpd.issue_Type in
#{issueType}
AND fpd.FINPROD_id in
#{finprodId}
AND fpd.VDATE >=to_date(#{vdateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.VDATE <=to_date(#{vdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDATE >=to_date(#{mdateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDATE <=to_date(#{mdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
group by fpd.finprod_id , fpd.finprod_abbr , fpd.finprod_name , fpd.FINPROD_TYPE , fpd.profit_type , fpd.issue_price , fpd.issue_amt , fpd.issue_Type , fpd.CCY , fpd.CCY , fpd.VDATE , fpd.MDATE , fpd.iDATE , fpd.actmdate, ext.sale_period , ext.sale_layer,
ext.profit_flag, ext.IS_RECONCILIATION, fpd.o_Finprod_Id , fpd.is_chl , fpd.is_sus , fpd.is_right , bbext.PARAM_VALUE, fpd.CALENDAR_ID , C.CALENDAR_NAME order by fpd.VDATE desc,fpd.profit_type

select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.p_Finprod_Id pFinprodId, pfpd.finprod_name pFinprodName, /* 挂钩母产品 名称 */ basi.acct_subject_name acctSubjectName, /* 投资组合 名称 */ fpd.issue_price issuePrice, fpd.issue_amt issueAmt, fpd.issue_Type issueType, fpd.CCY ccyCode, fpd.CCY ccy, fpd.REGIST_ORG registOrg, /*托管机构 */ crule.yield * 100 yield, /*预期收益率*/ '' investType, '' raiseType, to_char(fpd.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(fpd.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate, to_char(fpd.iDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') idate, to_char(fpd.actmdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') actmdate, fpd.MDATE - fpd.vDATE term, 'A/365' basis, ext.sale_period salePeriod, case when coalesce(ext.sale_layer, 0) != 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end isSaleLayer,
ext.profit_flag prdIncomeType, ext.profit_flag prdIncomeTypeCode, decode(ext.IS_RECONCILIATION, 'Y', 'true', 'false') isReconciliation, fpd.o_Finprod_Id oFinprodId, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, amt.trade_amt planraiseAmt, decode(bbext.PARAM_VALUE, 'Y', 'true', 'false') isTrustCurrent, fpd.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, C.CALENDAR_NAME AS calendarName from FIN_PRODUCT fpd left join (select a.* from fin_cash_calc_rule a left join FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id where b.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02') crule on crule.EFF_DATE = fpd.VDATE and crule.FINPROD_ID = fpd.FINPROD_ID and crule.FINPROD_TYPE = fpd.FINPROD_TYPE left join FIN_PRODUCT pfpd on pfpd.finprod_id = fpd.p_finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ext on fpd.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id /*and fpd.finprod_type = ext.finprod_type*/ /*产品信息查询募集金额查询不到bug修改*/ left join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO basi on basi.acct_subject_id = ext.portfolio_id left join (select sum(tpd.trade_amt) trade_amt, tpd.finprod_id, tpd.settle_date, tpd.finprod_type from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd group by tpd.finprod_id, tpd.settle_date, tpd.finprod_type) amt on fpd.finprod_id = amt.finprod_id and amt.settle_date = fpd.VDATE and amt.finprod_type = fpd.finprod_type LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO C ON C.CALENDAR_ID = fpd.CALENDAR_ID /*产品信息查询募集金额查询不到bug修改*/ LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbext ON bbext.BOOKSET_ID = fpd.finprod_id AND bbext.PARAM_CODE = 'PRD_IS_CALC' where 1=1
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND fpd.profit_Type in
#{profitType}
AND fpd.issue_Type in
#{issueType}
AND fpd.FINPROD_id in
#{finprodId}
AND fpd.VDATE >=to_date(#{vdateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.VDATE <=to_date(#{vdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDATE >=to_date(#{mdateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDATE <=to_date(#{mdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by fpd.VDATE desc,fpd.profit_type

select prd.finprod_id id, coalesce(prd.finprod_abbr,prd.finprod_name) text from fin_product prd where 1=1
AND prd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND (prd.finprod_id like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR prd.finprod_abbr like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR prd.finprod_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by prd.finprod_id

select crule.yield * 100 yield, /* 生效利率 */ to_char(crule.EFF_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') effDate /* 生效日 */ FROM FIN_CASH_INFO info LEFT JOIN fin_cash_calc_rule crule ON info.cash_id = crule.cash_id AND info.finprod_id = crule.finprod_id AND info.finprod_type = crule.finprod_type LEFT JOIN fin_cash_pay_rule prule ON info.cash_id = prule.cash_id AND info.finprod_id = prule.finprod_id AND info.finprod_type = prule.finprod_type WHERE info.cash_type_1 = '03' and info.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and info.cash_type_2 = #{cashType2} order by crule.EFF_DATE asc

SELECT A.PARAM_CODE AS paramCode, A.PARAM_VALUE AS paramValue FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON C.FINPROD_ID = B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND C.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} WHERE C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
